archive.name: Name
archive.credentialHint: Credentials are stored privately on the server and never returned. Use HTTPS in production and a new reference when rotating, then verify the target.
archive.policyHint: Saving the interval, remote retention and capacity budget pauses archiving and expiry governance. Enable each explicitly.
archive.cleanupSeparate: This configures archiving. Set source retention and deletion mode in Automatic governance.
archive.enableHint: Enabling permits actual log transfers. Disabling stops new transfers without erasing history or switching to direct deletion.
archive.importHint: Read and verify historical manifests and objects from this target only. This does not enable archiving or delete Mac or server data.
archive.previewHint: Verify before viewing, up to 64 KiB. Never overwrite active logs or restore a database.
archive.truncated: Only the first 64 KiB is shown. Download for the complete file.
archive.modeHint: Disabling archiving does not enable deletion. Direct deletion still protects active files, recent segments, references and unknown sources.
archive.gcScheduleHint: This is a separate expiry switch. Enabled schedules only collect expired, unreferenced archives; retention is never shortened automatically.
archive.gcHint: Only expired versions that pass reference checks are collected. Object bytes do not prove immediate filesystem reclamation. Uncertain outcomes require reconciliation.
archive.migrationHint: Choose an enabled policy for a different verified target. Verify and protect the copied archive; retain the old objects.
archive.handoffBlocked: Legacy scripts have not adopted the control protocol. UI switches govern native tasks; deploy the handoff before they can govern legacy scripts.
archive.workerOff: This Core has no archive scheduler. Check worker configuration or the independent executor; manual runs still require explicit enablement.

execution.hint: The original job and local content are retained. Incomplete captures cannot resume. Complete snapshots can be explicitly retransferred using the original job. New policy runs and partial-content reclamation remain blocked pending review.
execution.retryHint: Retransfer this complete local snapshot using its original job ID. Current policy, target and content will be checked again. No new capture is created; some remote objects may already exist.

commandConfirmation.title: Review local command
commandConfirmation.hint: Review the original startup identity and process group exit evidence, then explicitly record human confirmation.
commandConfirmation.scope: Local proof applies only to this command. It does not close the capture, delete content, retry or enable policies. Review remote receivers separately.
commandConfirmation.reviewHint: Verify original task, execution, command, recovery epoch and kernel identity within the same boot. A missing PID alone is not drain proof.
commandConfirmation.pendingHint: Keep the original ID and read the same request. Missing, failed, mismatched or historical receipts cannot establish current eligibility. No automatic submission.
commandConfirmation.effect: Confirm only this local process group exit
commandConfirmation.effectHint: Keep the original task and command. No deletion or policy enablement. Independently review content before disposing of an interrupted capture; other unknown commands remain protected.
commandConfirmation.confirmLabel: I reviewed the original execution and full startup identity. This records local group drain only, not remote commit success.

problems.eligible: Complete startup identity, with original process and group absent in the same boot. Ready for explicit human review.
problems.command_not_unconfirmed: This record is not an unknown running command eligible for confirmation.
problems.identity_missing: Legacy or incomplete startup identity. Do not invent proof; keep protection.
problems.boot_changed: Boot or namespace changed. Keep protection.
problems.identity_mismatch: This PID now has a different startup identity and may have been reused. Do not release protection or signal it.
problems.group_not_drained: The process or group remains, or kernel observation is incomplete. Keep protection.
problems.probe_scope_missing: Legacy probe has no original target binding; protection remains.
problems.probe_policies_active: Pause every policy referencing the original target first.

probe.effect: Confirms only that the original local probe command exited. It does not verify the current target or enable archiving or cleanup.

commands.unconfirmed: Local external command exit is unconfirmed
commands.protection: {count} local commands lack drain proof. Keep original tasks and content; disposition, collection and replacement execution remain protected. Review execution ownership; do not remove records to bypass this gate. Local exit does not prove remote receiver exit.
commands.active: {count} local external commands are running; cancellation or service close waits for their local process groups.

disposition.title: Review interrupted capture
disposition.hint: Review the original job, retain existing content and explicitly close this capture.
disposition.scope: Only incomplete captures qualify. Use Retransfer original job for complete snapshots. Active executors must drain. Explicitly pause archiving and remote cleanup for the original policy first.
disposition.ineligible: This job is ineligible. Return to the catalog to retransfer a complete snapshot.
disposition.verifyHint: Read-only verification of existing CAS objects: up to 10000 objects, 64 GiB and five minutes. Shared objects may include other jobs and will be conservatively retained. Staging files stay in place and are not certified as a complete archive.
disposition.effect: Retain content and close this capture
disposition.effectHint: Retain the original ID, existing objects and audit. Do not delete source or remote files or claim an incomplete capture is complete. The policy stays paused and requires separate explicit enablement. Retention does not reclaim space.
disposition.confirmLabel: Retain existing content and close the original capture without restarting or creating a replacement
disposition.unknownHint: The original request is retained. Read only its receipt; missing evidence, errors or historical receipts after recovery never replay the operation.
disposition.retained: Original capture closed; content protected. Policy enablement remains a separate decision.
disposition.rejected: Original request rejected. Protection remains; verify again before a new review.
disposition.resultUnknown: The original result is unknown or historical only. Current protection remains; keep the request ID.
disposition.receiptProblem: Receipt identity or content does not match. The original request remains locked.
disposition.contextProblem: Saved session request is unreadable. New submissions are blocked pending review.
disposition.reviewIncomplete: Verification did not complete. Content and protection remain; explicitly verify again.
disposition.pauseRequired: Pause archiving and remote cleanup in the original policy first. Log policies are on this page; media policies are in Backup Center.

closure.title: Review unknown disposition
closure.reviewHint: Review the original request, input digest, current protection and recovery epoch. This neither repeats retention nor proves it never executed.
closure.upgrade: This Core does not support controlled closure yet. Upgrade before reviewing; keep the original ID.
closure.protection: The original task remains interrupted; request and policy locks are available. This does not prove external commands have exited.
closure.sameEpoch: The recovery epoch matches registration. Historical execution remains unknown.
closure.changedEpoch: The recovery epoch changed. Historical execution remains unknown; this conclusion binds current protection.
closure.effect: Close the unknown request and keep task protection
closure.closedHint: Keep the original outcome unknown and record the reason and operator. No files are deleted, no action is replayed and interruption protection remains. Review content independently before disposing of the task.
closure.pending: Closure response is unconfirmed. Reconcile the original request above; no automatic submission.
closure.confirm: I reviewed this request, accept its unknown historical outcome and confirm all current task protection remains.

dbRetention.title: Database retention
dbRetention.scope: Only invocation audits and publication notifications for registered tenants of this instance; business event queues are excluded.
dbRetention.summary: At least {success} days for success, {failure} for failures and {quarantine} after quarantine; references and protection can extend retention.
dbRetention.reclaim: Deleted rows become reusable after ordinary VACUUM; filesystem free space may not increase. When safe reclamation is insufficient, reject new calls or expand capacity.
dbRetention.adopt: Adopt legacy pending only after tenant, terminal trace and payload verification
dbRetention.reject: Reject new capability calls at the budget or critical disk threshold (existing work continues)
dbRetention.enable: Enable database expiry cleanup (automatic when workers are enabled)

archives.guideSchedule: Enable each policy separately. Defaults: local 7 days / 168 snapshots, remote 90 days / 2160 snapshots. Keep protected, latest and untransferred snapshots. The independent archive timer can run while Core is stopped; SSH keys and host trust are deployed by operators.
archives.guideRestore: Restore into a separate directory; follow the paired database in Restored copies. Current database, media paths and S3 Bucket remain in use. Ordinary PostgreSQL SQL logs support investigation, not WAL/PITR recovery.
archives.title: Media and remote archives

archives.restoreHint: Create a separate directory and, when included, a separate database. PowerX keeps its current database and media directory. S3 objects are restored as files in the new directory.
archives.cleanupHint: Prune registered snapshots and unreferenced objects according to policy. Keep the latest, protected and untransferred snapshots. Remote retention is independent.
archives.runHint: Capture an incremental snapshot and transfer it when a remote target is configured. A paired database dump uses additional storage.

backupCenter.formHint: The source is the current Core connection. Backups are local dump files; no target database connection is required.
backupCenter.retentionExplanation: Age and count: files expire when either limit is exceeded. The latest copy and protected copies are always kept. Successful jobs count; cleanup runs after a successful backup or manually. Saving policy changes does not delete files immediately.
backupCenter.verifyHint: Disabled by default. Verification creates a fresh database and removes it afterward by default; it never overwrites production.
backupCenter.cleanupConfirm: Expired files are permanently removed according to each policy. Latest and protected copies remain. Protect important copies first.
backupCenter.verifyConfirm: Verify SHA256 and restore to a fresh isolated database. Existing databases are untouched. The new test database is removed afterward by default.
backupCenter.invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, e.g. Asia/Shanghai
backupCenter.saved: Policy saved. Verify a first backup before enabling the schedule.
backupCenter.backupSucceeded: Backup succeeded. Check the file and SHA256, then verify restore.
backupCenter.verifySucceeded: Isolated restore verification succeeded. Production was not switched.
backupCenter.pruned: No available artifact record (possibly expired); job audit retained
backupCenter.recoveryStep1: Select a system snapshot and check its database, media, configuration and program scope.
backupCenter.recoveryStep2: Validate on a separate clean PowerX server by importing and restoring the complete package. Production stays unchanged.
backupCenter.recoveryStep3: To restore this site, confirm instance replacement. The coordinator validates, enters maintenance and saves a protection snapshot.
backupCenter.recoveryStep4: Restore replaces the database, media, official configuration and matching programs, then verifies and resumes service. No environment selection or switching is required.
backupCenter.recoveryStep5: Verify business records and files, then restart normally and check again. Restore the protection snapshot if the prior state is required.
backupCenter.recoveryBoundary: Restore replaces the target installation. Its protection snapshot must succeed first. Restored data and configuration survive normal restarts. Unsupported deployments are blocked explicitly.
backupCenter.restoreHistoryHint: Verification uses a fresh isolated database and never switches production. Expand a record for its target, table count and report.
backupCenter.probeKept: The isolated database was kept for inspection; operations must remove it after verification.
backupCenter.probeRemoved: The isolated database was removed; the backup file remains.

workspace.subtitle: Manage backup policies, execution results and restore verification.
workspace.cleanupBrief: Remove expired backups according to policy retention rules.
workspace.formatHelp: Data is stored in PostgreSQL custom .dump archives restored with pg_restore. The same directory contains a .dump.sha256 checksum and a .dump.json manifest.
workspace.scheduleHelp: Enabled policies run at their configured intervals. Back up now runs once and does not change whether a policy is enabled.
workspace.verificationHelp: Automatic restore verification is a separate setting. It checks recoverability at its own interval; disabling it does not stop scheduled backups.
workspace.troubleshootJob: Expand a failed job to inspect the error and Trace ID and identify the failing step.
workspace.troubleshootRuntime: Check the source database, backup directory and dependencies under Runtime settings.
workspace.troubleshootTrace: Find the job Trace ID in Logs / Trace or server logs, fix the cause, then retry the operation.
workspace.verificationScope: Restore verification checks an archive and restores it in a fresh isolated database. Inspect its target database, table count and result report.
workspace.availableHint: Successful jobs with registered backup files. File existence and checksums are checked again when restoring.
workspace.historyHint: All executions, including failures and jobs without file records. Past success does not guarantee a restorable file.

snapshots.title: System snapshots
snapshots.storageHelpHint: Effective storage location, configuration priority and how to change it.
snapshots.storageYAMLHint: Set an independent directory in Core config.yaml. Leave it empty to retain the default; replace the path below with an absolute path.
snapshots.storageProfileHint: Managed deployments use this coordinator JSON field with the highest priority:
snapshots.storageMoveHint: Restart Core after changing configuration; update the coordinator for managed deployments. Existing snapshots are not moved automatically. To preserve history, stop the services and move the entire original directory, including master.key, ledgers and contents, before switching.
snapshots.scopeDescription: Save database, media, configuration and programs together. Restore replaces this instance. Validate on a separate clean server; supported scope is shown in snapshot details.
snapshots.empty: Create the first snapshot from the current system policy, or import a complete recovery package.
snapshots.passwordHint: Use at least 12 bytes. Keep the passphrase separately; importing requires the same passphrase. A lost passphrase cannot be recovered.
snapshots.captureHint: Captures database, media, configuration and programs online without pausing business writes. Changes after the recovery point belong to the next snapshot. Concurrent source changes trigger bounded backup retries.
snapshots.onlinePackageScope: Isolated data recovery or local rehearsal only; not a production whole-site recovery point.
snapshots.restoreConsent: Create an isolated data copy without switching the live site.
snapshots.restoreHint: Prepares database, media and private configuration copies together. Does not start the copied application or switch the live site.
snapshots.policyHint: One policy captures all components. Retention must cover at least one interval. Existing database and media policies stay as configured.
snapshots.requireSystemPolicy: Select a system default policy. Manual snapshots work with scheduling turned off.
snapshots.capturePolicyChanged: The system default changed. Close this dialog and start again from the current system default.
snapshots.manualCaptureHint: This manual backup does not change the schedule setting.
snapshots.retentionSummary: Keep for {days} days, up to {count} copies
snapshots.noPolicies: No snapshot policies yet. Create a policy to get started.
snapshots.multiplePoliciesHint: Save multiple policies; manual backups use the system default. Scheduling only controls automatic backups. Switching the default leaves scheduling off.
snapshots.defaultSwitchHint: Enabling this policy makes it the default and disables other policies. No snapshot is created immediately.
snapshots.policySummaryHint: This instance uses one unified snapshot policy to capture the database, media, configuration and programs together.
snapshots.policyDisabledHint: Automatic snapshots are off. To test now, manually create a snapshot in Recovery points.
snapshots.policyScheduledHint: A snapshot will be created at the next scheduled time. Saving the policy does not create a snapshot immediately.
snapshots.packageHint: Complete packages contain sensitive data and use an independent passphrase. Choose a trusted file and storage location.
snapshots.deleteHint: Permanently remove this snapshot record and its package files, including database, media, encrypted configuration and program copies. Running system data stays unchanged.
snapshots.deleteConsent: I confirm permanent deletion of this snapshot record and its files. It will no longer be available for recovery.
snapshots.deleteProtectedConsent: I confirm permanent deletion of this protected snapshot and its files, giving up this rollback point.
snapshots.deleteProtectedHint: This protected snapshot is excluded from automatic cleanup. You can still delete it manually with explicit confirmation, which removes this rollback recovery point.
snapshots.deleteHistoryHint: Staging files for related finished recovery jobs are also removed. Operation audits and recovery history are retained.
snapshots.deleteActiveHint: The snapshot is being captured or verified and cannot be deleted.
snapshots.deleteRecoveryHint: Finish or resolve the current recovery task before deleting snapshots.
snapshots.deleteSuccess: The snapshot record and its files were permanently deleted.
snapshots.deleteIncomplete: Cleanup was not confirmed complete. Refresh the record and retry.

recovery.title: System restore
recovery.description: Restore a snapshot into this PowerX instance. A protection snapshot is saved first. Validate on a separate clean server.
recovery.offline: The independent coordinator is offline. Recovery and switching are unavailable.
recovery.empty: No restore tasks yet. Select a snapshot to restore this instance.
recovery.noAutomaticRollback: Writes may have resumed. Automatic rollback is stopped; review new data in the candidate first.
recovery.prepareHint: Restore enters maintenance and replaces the database, media, application configuration and matching programs. A protection snapshot is saved first. Normal restarts keep the restored configuration.
recovery.cutoverHint: Enter maintenance, stop writers and save the current rollback point, then switch database, media, configuration and programs together.
recovery.prepareConsent: I confirm replacing this instance. Later changes will be preserved in the protection snapshot.
recovery.cutoverConsent: I accept the maintenance impact and confirm switching the whole production environment to this candidate
recovery.waiting: Maintenance or restart is in progress. Waiting for the coordinator; do not submit again.
recovery.scopeDescription: Save database, media, configuration and programs together. Restore replaces this instance. Validate on a separate clean server; supported scope is shown in snapshot details.
recovery.switched: Instance restored. Reopen the site and verify its data. Sign in again if required.
recovery.overwriteHint: Tool-managed local development only. Verify the snapshot, save the current rollback point, then replace the database, media and configuration.
recovery.localOnlineHint: This package does not meet the production whole-site recovery contract. Local rehearsal covers business data; queue and external dependency limits appear in its verification report.
recovery.rollbackHint: Save a rollback point, then return to the complete original environment. New changes remain in the rollback package and are not merged.
recovery.cleanupHint: Delete this inactive environment's database, media, configuration and programs. Keep snapshots and execution records. Active and retained rollback environments cannot be removed.
recovery.actionConsent: I reviewed the environment and impact and confirm this action.
recovery.openCurrentSite: Check current site in a new window
recovery.installationRequired: This installation has not been registered for in-place restore. Complete deployment configuration first.
recovery.maintenanceHint: Maintenance is active. Keep this page open for independent restore progress. Writes remain disabled if intervention is required.
recovery.unsupportedSnapshot: This snapshot cannot restore the current instance. Export it for verification in a supported installation.

availability.offline: This site's restore service is offline. Start it and refresh. Existing snapshots are retained.

availability.maintenance: This site is under maintenance. View progress in Full-instance restore.
availability.busy: An existing task is running or needs attention. View its status in Full-instance restore.
availability.error: Could not read this site's restore status. Check the service and refresh. Existing snapshots are retained.

verify.title: Integrity check
verify.hint: Read the full backup and check SHA256, manifest, and checksum file. Maximum 5 minutes. Closing or disconnecting stops the read; it never retries automatically.
verify.incomplete: The check did not complete. Connection, lock or record state may have changed. No success result was produced; inspect and retry manually.
verify.diagnosticOnly: This is a file consistency diagnostic, not a restore test or permission to unlock/delete. Results are not persisted; existing cleanup markers remain.

states.verified: SHA256, registered metadata and sidecars match
states.checksum_mismatch: Backup SHA256 differs from registered metadata
states.sidecar_mismatch: Manifest or checksum sidecar does not match
states.sidecars_missing: Backup SHA256 matches; a sidecar is missing
states.missing: Backup absent; cleanup completion is unconfirmed
states.unsafe: Unsafe file path, type or link
states.changed: File or cleanup record changed during the check
states.unavailable: File or record could not be read

backupReview.title: Backup cleanup review
backupReview.hint: Cleanup may be in progress or unconfirmed. Review the record and file metadata; this page keeps all existing safety locks.
backupReview.recordProblem: Incomplete record. Inspection is unavailable and the safety lock remains.
backupReview.inspectHint: Read-only file and cleanup diagnostics. No deletion, unlock, or cleanup confirmation.
backupReview.stale: The cleanup record may have changed. Inspect the current record again.
backupReview.noProof: Presence does not prove integrity; absence does not prove completed deletion. This inspection creates no integrity proof.
backupReview.nextHint: Open the original task to download, verify, or protect the backup. Cleanup locks remain and may block protection. Do not retry deletion based on this inspection.
backupReview.loadFailed: Cleanup reviews could not be loaded. Safety status is unknown; refresh to retry.
backupReview.inspectFailed: Inspection failed. The record may have changed or the service is unavailable.
backupReview.noLongerListed: This record is absent from the current page. Close and locate it again; absence does not confirm completed cleanup.
backupReview.attentionFailed: Backup cleanup status is unknown. Open cleanup review.

results.missing: All three files absent; review required

backupRetain.checking: This request is admitted; its outcome is still unknown. Read the original receipt before making another decision.
backupRetain.modalHint: Recheck on the server, add backup protection and store a receipt. No files are deleted and cleanup locks remain.
backupRetain.snapshotOld: The displayed file snapshot predates this operation. Use its receipt for the operation outcome; reload to inspect current files.
backupRetain.title: Confirm retention
backupRetain.hint: The server rechecks the full files, then protects the backup and stores a request receipt. Cleanup state and token remain. No disk space is reclaimed and deletion is not confirmed. Pause automatic execution and the backup policy first.
backupRetain.reviewUnavailable: A current review version is unavailable. Check storage control and recovery protection before confirming retention. File inspection remains available.
backupRetain.legacyHistory: This legacy request has only a database record and no independent recovery record. Keep its original UUID for historical review; execution is blocked.
backupRetain.recoveryBlocked: The original request identity is preserved; its final outcome is unknown. This view will not execute or resend it. Keep the UUID to read its receipt; this is not proof that an in-flight request has stopped.
backupRetain.unknown: Outcome unknown. Keep the original request ID; read its receipt or explicitly retry the same input. Do not create a new request.
backupRetain.kept: This receipt records protection added at that time, with the cleanup lock preserved. Recheck current state after a restore or another operation. It is not deletion approval.
backupRetain.unchanged: This receipt does not confirm current protection. The cleanup intent remains. Reload the current record; this does not prove that no action occurred before a restore.
backupRetain.pauseRequired: Pause automatic execution and this backup policy, then review again.
backupRetain.originalOnly: This operation is bound to the original request ID and input. Reopen this intent to recover an unfinished request.
backupRetain.confirm: Keep and protect this backup, preserving its cleanup lock.
backupRetain.loadFailed: Operation records unavailable. Check this feature migration and service status, then refresh. Existing protection remains.
backupRetain.noReceipt: The original receipt is unavailable. Not found does not prove non-execution: a database restore can rewind history. Keep and reconcile the original request ID; do not automatically replace it.

backupResolution.title: Resolve intent and retain
backupResolution.hint: Verify this backup and drain cooperating tasks before retaining the current cleanup intent. Preserve the token and unknown history; no file deletion or schedule enablement.
backupResolution.unknown: Outcome unknown. Keep the original UUID and reconcile it; do not create another request.
backupResolution.disconnected: Realtime sync disconnected. The current request is preserved for manual reconciliation.
backupResolution.historical: Historical receipt of this resolution, not proof of current files or protection. Original unknown history remains unchanged.
backupResolution.checkpoint: SQL confirmed the disposition; the independent checkpoint is pending. Continuing the original request only saves that receipt.
backupResolution.running: Reading and verifying the complete backup
backupResolution.originalOnly: The UUID and input are frozen. A failed lookup does not prove non-execution. Only an explicit identical retry is allowed.
backupResolution.blocked: Not ready: check published pause, recovery acknowledgement and historical coverage.
backupResolution.unknownCount: {count} historical outcomes remain unknown and will stay unchanged after this resolution.
backupResolution.confirm: After current-file verification and task drain, retain this intent while preserving its token and unknown history. No files will be deleted.
backupResolution.loadFailed: Current conditions could not be checked. Content is preserved and submission is blocked.
backupResolution.noReceipt: The original receipt is unavailable. Keep its UUID; this does not prove non-execution.

states.rejected: This operation left the intent unchanged

backupQuarantine.hint: Logically isolate a missing or incomplete backup from downloads and restore. Preserve files, the cleanup token and history; this does not prove a valid backup.
backupQuarantine.unknown: Outcome unknown. Keep the original UUID and reconcile it; do not create another request.
backupQuarantine.disconnected: Realtime sync disconnected. The current request is preserved for manual reconciliation.
backupQuarantine.historical: Historical receipt for this quarantine; the original unknown execution history is preserved.
backupQuarantine.checkpoint: SQL confirmed the disposition; the independent checkpoint is pending. Continuing the original request only saves that receipt.
backupQuarantine.originalOnly: The UUID and input are frozen. A failed lookup does not prove non-execution. Only an explicit identical retry is allowed.
backupQuarantine.confirm: Quarantine this artifact without deleting files or treating it as a valid backup
backupQuarantine.loadFailed: Current conditions could not be checked. Content is preserved and submission is blocked.
backupQuarantine.noReceipt: The original receipt is unavailable. Keep its UUID; this does not prove non-execution.

states.rejected: This operation left the intent unchanged

backupQuarantine.noProof: This records a current diagnosis. Quarantine does not repair a backup or free disk space.
backupQuarantine.diagnosisIncomplete: Check incomplete or conditions changed. Run an explicit new check before submitting.

quarantineInventory.hint: Historical quarantine decisions and current database markers are separate. Historical success proves neither current quarantine nor a usable backup.
quarantineInventory.coverageGap: {count} quarantine markers have no attributable decision for this instance. Coverage is incomplete; check backup execution history.
quarantineInventory.observed: {count} decisions · observed {time} · sizes are current registered values
quarantineInventory.readOnlyHint: Inspect current files only. This cannot release quarantine, repair files, rewrite history or enable downloads and restore.
quarantineInventory.stale: Current state is unconfirmed. Retained details are an older snapshot; read current state before inspection.
quarantineInventory.historicalOnly: This records a past decision. The current database marker is shown separately above.
quarantineInventory.cannotInspect: Source missing, identity changed or history conflicts; file inspection is unavailable.
quarantineInventory.noRestoreProof: This is a temporary read-only file diagnosis. Even complete content does not release quarantine or authorize restore.
quarantineInventory.loadFailed: Inventory unavailable; current state is unknown. Previous results are retained. Refresh manually.
quarantineInventory.detailFailed: Current details are unconfirmed. Previous snapshot retained; inspection is blocked.
quarantineInventory.incomplete: Inspection interrupted, incomplete or conditions changed. Read current state before retrying.

history.sql_missing: SQL receipt missing; independent historical result retained
